test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the situation in the sentence, select the most appropriate idiom.

Although Greta Thunberg gave a moving speech at the UN about environmental damage, it could _________.

options.text: be the icing on the cake

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"cut no ice"** means to **have no influence or effect; it is used when something fails to impress or persuade. (कोई प्रभाव नहीं डालना)**

 
 
• **Example: **His excuses** cut no ice **with the teacher, who still gave him a failing grade.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Break the ice** (बातचीत शुरू करना): To do or say something to relieve tension or get conversation going in a social setting.

 
 
• **Example:** He told a joke to **break the ice** at the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Walk on thin ice** (खतरे में होना): To be in a risky or dangerous situation.
 
 
• **Example: **He's **walking on thin ice** by lying to the boss.
 
 
 
• **Be the icing on the cake** (अतिरिक्त लाभ): An additional benefit or positive aspect to something that is already considered positive or beneficial.
 
 
• **Example:** Getting a promotion was great, but the bonus **was the icing on the cake.**
 
 

19b:Tbf0,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
